name: Alert
description: You gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you can swap Initiative with a willing ally.

name: Crafter
description: You gain tool proficiencies, a discount on nonmagical items, and can craft faster.

name: Healer
description: You can use a Healer's Kit to restore hit points, and your healing rolls treat a 1 as a 2.

name: Lucky
description: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, spent to gain Advantage or impose Disadvantage.

name: Magic Initiate
description: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from a chosen class's spell list.

name: Musician
description: You gain musical instrument proficiencies and can grant Heroic Inspiration after a rest.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn you can reroll a melee weapon's damage dice and use either total.

name: Skilled
description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Your Unarmed Strike damage increases, and you can push a target as a bonus effect.

name: Tough
description: Your hit point maximum increases by twice your character level.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20.

name: Grappler
description: You have Advantage on attacks against creatures you are grappling.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: Heavy weapon crits and kills grant a bonus attack; you can trade accuracy for damage.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Your ranged attacks ignore cover and suffer no long-range Disadvantage.

name: War Caster
description: You have Advantage on Concentration saves and can cast as an Opportunity Attack.
